DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。地域の掲示について、何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with community notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語とベトナム語を練習する住民の集まりを募集したいです。このチラシを掲示する前に、伝わり方を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住民の日本語とベトナム語の練習会を募集したいので、掲示前の自作チラシがどう伝わるか見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to recruit residents for a group to practice Japanese and Vietnamese. Before I post this flyer, could you check how its message comes across?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to recruit residents for Japanese and Vietnamese practice sessions, and ask someone to check how your homemade flyer reads before posting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 主催するのは住民の皆さんですね。表題の「市の交流会」は、市が主催するという意味で書きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: The residents themselves will be organizing it, correct? Did you write “city exchange gathering” in the title to mean that the city is organizing it?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、住民が自分たちで開く予定です。市内で行うという意味でしたが、市主催のように見えますね。表題を「住民有志の交流練習」に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 市内という意味で市の交流会と書いたが市主催ではなく住民が開くため、住民有志の交流練習へ表題を直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, residents plan to organize it ourselves. I meant that it would take place within the city, but it does look as though the city is hosting it. I'd like to change the title to “Volunteer residents' exchange practice.”
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that “city exchange gathering” meant within the city, but residents, not the city, are organizing it, so you want to change the title to “Volunteer residents' exchange practice.”

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表題をそのように直しました。日時は毎週土曜とありますが、場所と参加者の予定は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've changed the title accordingly. The date says every Saturday. Have you decided on the venue and who will participate?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。まず関心のある人を募る段階なので、毎週土曜とは書かず「日時は参加希望者と調整」としたいです。参加者もまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日時も会場も未定で関心のある人を募る段階なので、毎週土曜でなく参加希望者と日時調整と書きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. We're just looking for interested people at this stage, so instead of every Saturday, I'd like it to say “Date and time to be arranged with interested participants.” We haven't decided who will participate yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the date and venue are undecided and you are recruiting interested people; ask to replace “every Saturday” with a date and time to be arranged with interested participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日時の行も調整中に直しました。下にはご自宅の住所があります。掲示を見る人全員へ、その住所を知らせるつもりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've also changed the date line to say it is being arranged. Your home address appears below. Do you intend to share that address with everyone who sees the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家で開くと決まったわけではありません。自宅住所は削り、連絡用のメールだけ載せたいです。会場が決まったら、参加する人へ別に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅開催は未定なので住所を削って連絡用メールだけを載せ、決まった会場は参加者へ別に知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: We haven't decided to hold it at my home. I'd like to remove my home address and include only a contact email. Once the venue is decided, I'll inform the participants separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a home venue is not decided, so you want to remove the address, keep only the contact email, and inform participants separately when a venue is decided.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 修正版を読みます。「住民有志の交流練習」、日時は希望者と調整、会場未定、連絡はメールです。市主催や毎週開催、自宅会場という表記は外しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll read the revised version: “Volunteer residents' exchange practice,” date and time to be arranged with interested people, venue undecided, contact by email. We've removed the statements suggesting a city organizer, weekly meetings, and a home venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その修正で合っています。住民有志で日時と会場は未定、自宅住所も載っていません。この版で掲示の申込みを相談したいです。掲載はまだ許可されていないと理解しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住民有志で日時と会場は未定、自宅住所なしという修正版を確認し、掲載未許可と理解したうえでこの版の掲示申込みを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those changes are correct. It is organized by volunteer residents, the date and venue are undecided, and my home address is not included. I'd like to discuss applying to post this version. I understand that posting has not been approved yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the revised version in Japanese: volunteer residents, date and venue undecided, no home address. Explain that you understand posting is not yet approved and want to discuss applying to post this version.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 修正版とご希望を掲示担当へ渡します。募集内容の修正はできましたが、掲載可否は担当の確認待ちです。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass the revised flyer and your request to the person responsible for notices. We've corrected the recruitment content, but permission to post it awaits their review. Thank you for coming to discuss it.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。税金のご相談ですか。どの書類についてお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is this a tax inquiry? Which documents are you having trouble with?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 去年二つの会社で働いて、源泉徴収票が二枚あります。申告が必要か相談したくて、札幌中税務署へ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 前年に二社で働き源泉徴収票が二枚あると伝え、申告が必要か相談したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I worked for two companies last year and have two withholding tax certificates. I came to the Sapporo Naka Tax Office to ask whether I need to file a return.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you worked for two companies last year and have two withholding tax certificates, and want to ask whether you need to file a return.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 申告が必要かは内容を確認して判断することになります。二枚とも、同じ年分の給与についての書類ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Whether you need to file will be determined after checking the details. Are both certificates for salary earned in the same year?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、同じ年です。前の会社を辞めてから今の会社に入りました。年末調整に前の会社の分が入っているかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二枚は同年分で転職によるものだと答え、前職分が現職の年末調整に入ったか不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the same year. I joined my current company after leaving the previous one. I don't know whether my previous company's salary was included in my year-end adjustment.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that both certificates are for the same year because you changed jobs, and explain that you do not know whether the previous salary was included in your current company's year-end adjustment.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それは確認したい点ですね。源泉徴収票を二枚とも相談担当者に見せてください。ほかにも税金の通知をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's something we should check. Please show both withholding tax certificates to the adviser. Have you brought any other tax notices?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒もあります。住民税と書いてあるので、源泉徴収票と一緒に、ここですべて直してもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住民税の通知も示し、税務署で全て扱ってもらえると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: I also have this envelope. It says resident tax, so I thought you could sort everything out here together with the withholding tax certificates.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the resident tax notice and explain in Japanese that you thought the tax office could handle everything.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 住民税と所得税では相談先が異なることがあります。封筒の差出人と問い合わせ先を確認して、どの相談をこちらで扱うか整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Resident tax and income tax may have different inquiry offices. Let's check the sender and contact information on the envelope, and sort out which inquiries we can handle here.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、源泉徴収票の相談と住民税通知の相談を分けます。まず、今の会社に年末調整の内容を確認してから相談した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 源泉徴収票と住民税の相談を分けると伝え、会社の年末調整内容を先に確認する必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll separate my questions about the withholding tax certificates from those about the resident tax notice. Should I first ask my current company what was included in the year-end adjustment?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will separate the two inquiries, and ask whether you need to check the company's year-end adjustment details first.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できる情報を整理すると説明しやすくなります。今ある書類で相談できる範囲と、追加で確認する項目を担当者に聞いてみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Organizing the information you can confirm will make it easier to explain. Let's ask the adviser what can be discussed with your current documents and what additional items need checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二枚の源泉徴収票を見せ、前の会社の給与が含まれているか不明だと伝えます。住民税の封筒は問い合わせ先を確認して別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を示して前職分の扱いは不明と伝え、住民税の封筒は問い合わせ先へ別に相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show both withholding tax certificates and explain that I don't know whether my previous company's salary was included. I'll check the contact information on the resident tax envelope and ask about that separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show both certificates, explain the uncertainty about your previous salary, and contact the office listed on the resident tax envelope separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類の種類と不明な点が整理できましたね。所得税の相談担当へ確認します。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We've sorted out the document types and the points that are unclear. I'll check with the income tax adviser. Thank you for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。参拝のことで何かお尋ねになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you would like to ask about visiting the shrine?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 北海道神宮に初めて来ました。どの順路で参拝するか知りたいです。友人に見せるために動画も撮ろうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めての参拝なので順路を知りたいと伝え、友人向けの動画撮影も考えていると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: This is my first visit to Hokkaido Jingu. I'd like to know which route to follow for worship. I'm also thinking of filming a video to show my friends.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that this is your first shrine visit and you want to know the route, and that you are considering recording a video for friends.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 順路は案内表示で確認できます。撮影は場所ごとに確認が必要です。参拝している間も、ずっと撮るご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can check the route on the signs. Filming permission needs to be checked for each area. Were you planning to keep filming while worshipping too?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、入口から歩きながら撮るつもりでした。でも、ほかの人がお参りする姿も写りそうで気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩きながら撮影する予定だったが他の参拝者も写るのが気になると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I was planning to film as I walked from the entrance. But I'm concerned that other people worshipping might appear in the video too.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you planned to film while walking, but are concerned about capturing other worshippers.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参拝する方の妨げにならず、撮影を控えるよう案内がある場所では止めてください。参拝と撮影を分ける方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please avoid disturbing worshippers, and stop filming wherever signs ask you to refrain. You could also keep worship and filming separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら、参拝中はカメラをしまいます。参拝が終わってから、建物だけ撮れる場所があるか確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 参拝中は撮影をやめ、終わってから建物だけ撮れる場所を確認してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case, I'll put my camera away while worshipping. Afterwards, may I check whether there is somewhere I can film just the buildings?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will stop filming during worship, and ask whether you may check afterwards for places to film only the buildings.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。撮りたい場所を示して、撮影できるか担当者にお尋ねください。通路で立ち止まると、人の流れを遮る場合があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Show the staff the place you want to film and ask whether filming is permitted. Stopping in a walkway may obstruct the flow of people.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 立ち止まる場所にも気をつけます。友人への説明は、動画ではなく、見学した後に自分の言葉で録音することにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を塞がないようにすると伝え、友人への説明は見学後に自分の言葉で録音すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll also be careful where I stop. Instead of making a video explanation for my friends, I'll record an explanation in my own words after looking around.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid blocking walkways and record an explanation for your friends in your own words after your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それなら参拝中の方を写さずに伝えられますね。録音するときも、周囲の静かな環境に配慮して場所を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: That way, you can tell them about it without recording people worshipping. When recording your explanation, please also choose a place that respects the quiet surroundings.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず表示に沿って参拝し、撮影は許可を確認できた場所だけにします。説明の録音は、参拝の邪魔にならない所で後から行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示に沿って参拝し、撮影は許可を確認できた場所だけにして録音も妨げにならない場所で後から行うと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first follow the signs and worship, and film only in places where I've confirmed permission. I'll record my explanation afterwards somewhere that won't disturb worshippers.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will follow the signs to worship, film only where permission is confirmed, and record afterwards in a place that does not disturb others.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。周囲の方と案内に気を配りながらお進みください。どうぞ、よいお参りを。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please proceed while being considerate of others and following the guidance. Have a good visit. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。園内の回り方でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble finding your way around the zoo?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもと円山動物園を回っています。見たかった動物が展示の前から見えないので、今日は展示をしていないのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供と回る動物園で見たかった動物が見えないと説明し、展示休止か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm visiting Maruyama Zoo with my child. We can't see the animal we wanted to see from in front of its enclosure, so I'd like to know whether it isn't on display today.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are visiting the zoo with your child and cannot see the animal you wanted to see, and ask whether the exhibit is closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動物が見えないだけでは展示休止とは限りません。どの展示を見に行かれましたか。園内地図で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Not seeing the animal doesn't necessarily mean the exhibit is closed. Which exhibit did you visit? Could you point it out on the zoo map?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この地図の場所です。子どもは動物が出て来るまで待ちたいと言いますが、歩き疲れているようです。近くで休める所も探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示の場所を地図で示し、子供は待ちたいが疲れているので近くの休憩場所も探すと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: This place on the map. My child wants to wait until the animal comes out, but seems tired from walking. I'm also looking for somewhere nearby to rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the exhibit on the map and say in Japanese that your child wants to wait but is tired, so you are also looking for a nearby rest area.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その展示の案内を確認しましょう。動物を待つ時間はお約束できないので、先に休憩してから戻る方法もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the information for that exhibit. We can't promise how long you'll need to wait for the animal, so another option is to rest first and then return.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。戻った時も見えなければ、別の展示を見たいです。休憩場所から遠くまで歩かずに回れる経路を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に休憩し戻っても見えなければ別展示にすると伝え、遠くまで歩かず回る経路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: We'll do that. If we still can't see it when we return, we'd like to visit another exhibit. Could you help us plan a route that doesn't take us too far from the rest area?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will rest first and choose another exhibit if the animal is still not visible, and ask about a route without walking too far.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。現在地と休憩場所を地図で確認して、戻りやすい経路を考えましょう。近道に見えても、立入禁止の通路は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Let's locate where we are and the rest area on the map, then think of an easy route back. Even if it looks like a shortcut, please don't use any closed-off paths.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。地図の矢印だけを見ると一方通行に見える所がありますが、行ける方向は現地の表示でも確認した方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図の矢印が一方通行に見えると伝え、進める方向は現地表示でも確認した方がよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. Some arrows on the map make paths look one-way. Should I also check the signs on site to confirm which direction we can go?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the map arrows look one-way, and ask whether you should also check on-site signs for permitted directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。現地で迂回や通行方向の案内がある場合は、そちらに従ってください。迷ったら、次の展示へ進む前に係員に聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If there are on-site instructions about detours or walking directions, please follow them. If you're unsure, you can ask a staff member before moving to the next exhibit.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先に子どもを休ませ、展示の案内を見て戻るか決めます。近い展示を選び、移動の前に通行方向を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子供を休ませ展示案内で戻るか決め、近い展示を選んで移動前に通行方向を確かめると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll let my child rest first, then check the exhibit information and decide whether to return. We'll choose a nearby exhibit and confirm the walking direction before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will let your child rest, decide whether to return based on the exhibit information, choose nearby exhibits, and check walking directions before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それなら無理なく回れますね。地図で休憩場所を確認しましょう。お子さんの様子を見ながら、お楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: That should let you enjoy the zoo without overdoing it. Let's find the rest area on the map. Please enjoy your visit while keeping an eye on how your child is feeling.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご注文前に確認したいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is there anything you would like to check before ordering?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵を避ける必要があります。この料理は名前に卵が入っていないんですが、ソースにも卵が使われていないか確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵を避ける必要を伝え、料理名だけでなくソースにも含まれないか確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to avoid eggs. This dish doesn't have egg in its name, but could you check whether its sauce contains egg too?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you need to avoid eggs, and ask for a check beyond the dish's name, including whether the sauce contains egg.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 料理名だけでは判断できませんので、確認できるアレルゲン情報を見ます。卵のアレルギーについての確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can't judge from the dish's name alone, so I'll check the allergen information available to us. Are you asking because of an egg allergy?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、アレルギーがあります。料理の上にのった卵だけ取ればいいと思っていましたが、それでは足りないかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 卵アレルギーだと答え、上の卵を除けば足りると思っていたが材料全体の確認が必要だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I have an allergy. I thought I could just remove the egg on top of the dish, but that might not be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you have an egg allergy and thought removing the egg on top would be enough, but need all the ingredients checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 上の卵を取り除いても、ほかの材料に含まれている可能性があります。ソースを含めた材料と、確認できる情報の範囲を調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even if the egg on top is removed, other ingredients may contain egg. I'll check the ingredients, including the sauce, and the extent of the information we can confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 調理する時に、ほかの卵料理と同じ器具を使うかも気になります。そこまで確認できるか、担当の方に聞いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他の卵料理と調理器具を共有するかも気になると伝え、確認可能な範囲を担当へ聞いてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm also concerned about whether the same utensils are used for other egg dishes during cooking. Could you ask the person responsible whether that can be checked too?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are concerned about utensils shared with egg dishes, and ask the person responsible to check how much information can be confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、担当者に確認します。ただし、卵がまったく入らないと保証できない場合があります。確認できない点もそのままお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, I'll check with them. However, we may not be able to guarantee that no egg is present at all. I'll also tell you plainly about anything we cannot confirm.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 保証できない場合は、その料理は注文しません。メニューの中で選び直す前に、確認できたことと不明なことを分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保証できない料理は注文しないと伝え、選び直す前に確認できた点と不明点を分けて説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: If you can't guarantee that, I won't order this dish. Before I choose something else from the menu, please explain separately what has been confirmed and what is unknown.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not order a dish whose safety cannot be guaranteed, and ask for confirmed facts and unknown points to be explained separately before choosing again.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた材料表では、この料理のソースに卵が含まれています。器具を卵料理と分けられるかは未確認です。材料から卵を除けるとはご案内できませんので、この料理は選ばずに考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: The ingredient list we could check confirms that this dish's sauce contains egg. We have not confirmed whether utensils can be kept separate from egg dishes. We cannot tell you that egg can be removed from the ingredients, so please consider a choice other than this dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ソースに卵が含まれると確認できたので、この料理は注文しません。別の料理も器具の扱いが確認できていないなら、今日は食事の注文を見送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ソースに卵が含まれると分かったのでこの料理は注文せず、別料理の器具の扱いも未確認なら今日は食事を注文しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: Since you've confirmed that the sauce contains egg, I won't order this dish. If the handling of utensils for other dishes is also unconfirmed, I'll refrain from ordering food today.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not order this dish because the sauce contains egg, and will not order food today if utensil handling for other dishes is also unconfirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。食事の注文は受け付けずにおきます。確認に使った材料表をご覧になりたい場合はお知らせください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We won't take a food order. Please let us know if you would like to see the ingredient list we checked. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。ご入浴前に、どのようなことを確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to check before bathing?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 定山渓温泉で日帰り入浴をしたいです。着替えはありますが、タオルを忘れました。利用できるか、受付の流れも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日帰り入浴を希望するがタオルを忘れたと伝え、利用可否と受付の流れを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to take a day-use bath at Jozankei Onsen. I have a change of clothes, but I forgot my towel. I'd like to know whether I can use the baths and how reception works.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want a day-use bath but forgot your towel, and ask whether you can use the baths and how to register.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は日帰り利用を受け付けています。タオルは購入品と貸し出し品があります。購入したいですか、それとも借りて返すものをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: We are accepting day visitors today. Towels are available for purchase or rental. Would you like to buy one, or borrow one and return it?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このあと荷物を持って移動するので、濡れたタオルを持ち帰りたくありません。借りて返せるものがあるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 後で移動するので濡れたタオルを持ち帰りたくないと説明し、貸出と返却ができるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll be travelling with my luggage afterwards, so I don't want to take a wet towel with me. I'd like to know whether there is one I can borrow and return.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will travel afterwards and do not want to carry a wet towel, and ask whether you can rent and return one.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: タオルは借りられます。入浴後は、貸し出し品をこちらの入口の返却かごへ入れてください。購入するタオルとは別なので、貸し出し品はお持ち帰りにならないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can rent a towel. After bathing, please put the rented item in the return basket here at the entrance. Rental towels are separate from towels for purchase, so please don't take rental items home.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 借りて返せるなら、今日は利用したいです。スマートフォンや財布は浴室へ持って行かず、保管する場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: タオルを借りて返せると確認できたので利用したいと伝え、携帯と財布を浴室へ持たず保管する場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I can rent and return one, I'd like to use the baths today. Please tell me where I can store my phone and wallet instead of taking them into the bathing area.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to bathe now that towel rental and return are confirmed, and ask where to store your phone and wallet outside the bathing area.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: スマートフォンや財布は、脱衣所のロッカーへ保管してください。鍵には手首に付ける帯があります。鍵をロッカーの中へ置いたままにせず、帯でご自身が持って入浴します。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please store your phone and wallet in a changing-room locker. The key has a wristband. Rather than leaving the key inside the locker, wear the band and keep it with you while bathing.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、必要なものだけ持って脱衣所へ行きます。鍵を失くすのが心配なので、入浴中の持ち方も確認してから使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な物だけ脱衣所へ持つと伝え、入浴中に鍵をなくさない持ち方を確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll take only what I need to the changing room. I'm worried about losing the key, so I'd like to check how to carry it while bathing before using the locker.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take only necessary items to the changing room, and want to check how to keep the key from getting lost during bathing.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。この帯を手首に付け、鍵が手元にあることを確かめてください。ロッカーに入れる荷物と、借りたタオルを分けて準備できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Put this band around your wrist and make sure you have the key with you. You can prepare by separating what goes in the locker from the towel you rented.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 借りたタオルは入浴後に入口のかごへ返します。財布と携帯はロッカーへ入れ、鍵は手首の帯で持って利用します。受付をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 借りたタオルは入口のかごへ返し、財布と携帯はロッカー、鍵は手首の帯で持つと確認して受付を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll return the rented towel to the entrance basket after bathing. I'll put my wallet and phone in the locker and wear the key on the wristband while using the baths. Please register me.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will return the towel to the entrance basket, put your wallet and phone in the locker, and keep the key on your wristband, then ask to register.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。利用とタオルの料金を受付で確認してから、ロッカーへお進みください。お帰りの際は貸し出しタオルの返却もお願いします。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please confirm the admission and towel charges at reception before proceeding to the lockers. Please also return the rented towel when you leave. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。チェックインについてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Would you like to ask about checking in?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社が札幌グランドホテルを予約してくれたはずです。まだ部屋に入れなくても、荷物を預けて仕事へ行けるか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社手配の宿泊を確認し、部屋に入る前でも仕事へ行くため荷物を預けられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: My company should have booked the Sapporo Grand Hotel for me. Even if I can't enter my room yet, I'd like to check whether I can leave my luggage and go to work.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check your company-arranged stay in Japanese, and ask whether you can leave luggage to go to work before entering your room.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずご予約を確認します。ご本人のお名前での予約でしょうか。それとも会社名で手配されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, I'll check your reservation. Is it under your own name, or was it arranged under your company's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の名前だと思いますが、予約のメールは会社名で届いています。受付番号と宿泊日が写った画面を見せてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の名だと思うがメールは会社名だと説明し、番号と宿泊日の画面を見せてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: I think it's under my name, but the booking email came under the company's name. May I show you the screen displaying the booking number and dates of stay?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you think the booking is in your name but the email has the company name, and ask to show the booking number and stay dates on screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。画面の情報とお名前を照合します。予約が確認できるまでは、チェックインやお預かりの条件を確定できません。荷物は何点ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. I'll compare the screen details with your name. Until we confirm the reservation, we cannot finalize the check-in or luggage-storage conditions. How many pieces of luggage do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: スーツケース一つとパソコンのバッグ一つです。パソコンも預けるつもりでしたが、貴重品の扱いに条件があるなら自分で持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物はスーツケースとパソコンバッグだと伝え、貴重品の条件があればパソコンは自分で持つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: One suitcase and one laptop bag. I was planning to leave the laptop too, but if there are conditions concerning valuables, I'll take it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have a suitcase and laptop bag, and will carry the laptop yourself if conditions apply to valuables.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物の種類ごとに、お預かりできるかを確認します。パソコンは必要に応じて手元にお持ちください。取りに戻る予定もお聞かせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check whether each type of luggage can be stored. Please keep your laptop with you if necessary. Please also tell us when you plan to return to collect your luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事が終わったら戻りますが、時間はまだ決まっていません。預けられる場合、引き取りの時に必要なものを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仕事後に戻るが時刻は未定だと伝え、預けられる場合の引取に必要な物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll return after work, but the time isn't decided yet. If I can leave my luggage, please tell me what I'll need to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will return after work but do not yet know the time, and ask what is needed to collect stored luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 引換証などが必要になる場合は、お渡しする時に説明します。部屋への案内は、お戻りになってから予約内容と受付状況を確認して進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you need a claim ticket or something similar, we'll explain when we hand it to you. When you return, we'll check your booking details and the reception status before arranging access to your room.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。まず予約画面で確認してもらい、預けられる荷物と引き取り方法を聞きます。パソコンは分けて、自分で持って行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: まず予約を照合して預けられる荷物と引取方法を聞き、パソコンは分けて自分で持つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll first have you check the reservation screen and ask which luggage can be stored and how to collect it. I'll separate the laptop and take it with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will first have the booking checked, ask which bags can be stored and how to collect them, and carry the laptop separately yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは予約画面とお名前を確認させてください。順にご案内します。ようこそお越しくださいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let me check your reservation screen and name. I'll guide you through each step. Welcome to the hotel.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お飲み物のご注文で、ご希望はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Do you have any preferences for your drink order?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 温かいコーヒーを持ち帰りたいです。大きいサイズがあるなら選びたいんですが、量を見てから決めてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 温かいコーヒーの持帰りを希望し、大きいサイズがあれば量を確認してから選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a hot coffee to take away. If there's a large size, I'd like to choose it, but may I check the volume before deciding?
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want hot coffee to take away and would like to check the amount before choosing a large size, if available.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご用意できるのは、二百ミリリットルと三百五十ミリリットルです。温かいコーヒーをお持ち帰りになって、すぐにお飲みになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have 200-millilitre and 350-millilitre sizes. Will you be drinking your takeaway hot coffee straight away?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人の所まで歩いて持って行きます。自分の分と二つ買いたいんですが、途中でこぼさないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人宅まで二杯を歩いて運ぶと説明し、途中でこぼさないか不安だと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll walk to my friend's place with it. I'd like to buy two, including one for myself, but I'm worried about spilling them on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will carry two coffees on foot to your friend's home, and are worried about spilling them.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つを持って歩かれるんですね。持ち運び用の入れ物があるか確認します。片手は荷物でふさがっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll be walking with two cups, then. I'll check whether we have a carrier. Is one of your hands occupied with luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、片手に仕事のバッグを持っています。両手で二つのカップを持つのは難しいので、持ち運べる方法がなければ一つにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片手は仕事バッグで塞がると答え、運ぶ方法がなければ一杯に減らすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I'm carrying my work bag in one hand. It would be difficult to hold two cups in both hands, so if there's no way to carry them, I'll just get one.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that one hand holds your work bag, and say you will reduce the order to one cup if there is no way to carry two.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日は二杯をまとめて運ぶ資材をご用意できません。片手がふさがるなら一杯にする方法があります。ふたがあっても、バッグへ横に入れたり傾けたりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Today, we don't have a carrier for two cups. If one hand is occupied, one option is to buy just one cup. Even with a lid, please don't lay it sideways in your bag or tilt it.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、バッグの中には入れません。友人の分は少し待ってもらって、一緒に買いに来ることもできます。まず一つを持てるサイズでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: カップをバッグには入れず、まず持てる一杯を選び友人とは後で一緒に買う案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't put it in my bag. My friend could wait a little and come back with me to buy theirs. For now, please give me one in a size I can carry.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not put the cup in your bag, will first choose one you can carry, and could buy your friend's coffee together later.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二百ミリリットルの一杯でよろしいでしょうか。仕事バッグと分けて、空いている手でカップを立ててお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would one 200-millilitre cup be all right? Please keep it separate from your work bag and hold the cup upright in your free hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、二百ミリリットルを一杯お願いします。友人には後で一緒に買いに来ようと連絡し、カップは仕事バッグへ入れず立てて持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二百ミリリットルを一杯注文し、友人とは後で一緒に買いに来ると連絡して、カップは仕事バッグへ入れず立てて持つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, one 200-millilitre cup, please. I'll tell my friend we can come back together later, and I'll carry the cup upright without putting it in my work bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Order one 200-millilitre coffee in Japanese, say you will tell your friend to come back together later, and carry the cup upright outside your work bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: かしこまりました。温かいコーヒー二百ミリリットルを一杯お作りします。受取りの際に、ふたが閉まっているかもご確認ください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. I'll make one 200-millilitre hot coffee. When you collect it, please also check that the lid is closed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。現場へお越しのご用件を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. May I ask what brings you to the site?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 札幌駅北口の現場で資材の打ち合わせがあります。会社から『現場の佐藤さんに会って』と言われましたが、どこまで入っていいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 資材の打合せで担当者に会う指示を受けたが、現場へどこまで入れるか不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a meeting about materials at the site by Sapporo Station's north exit. My company told me to meet Mr. Sato at the site, but I don't know how far I'm allowed to enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you were told to meet the person responsible for a materials meeting, but do not know how far you may enter the site.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当者を確認するまで、ここでお待ちください。会社名と、連絡を受けた担当者の所属はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait here until we confirm the person you're meeting. Do you know the company name and the department of the contact you were given?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社名はこの名刺にあります。所属は聞いていません。さっき奥の方で手を振られたので、入っていい合図かと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社名を名刺で示し担当者の所属は不明だと答え、奥で手を振られたのを入場許可だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: The company name is on this business card. I wasn't told the department. Someone waved further inside earlier, so I thought it was a signal that I could enter.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the company name on the business card, say in Japanese that you do not know the contact's department, and explain that you mistook a wave inside for entry permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それは作業車両への誘導かもしれません。訪問者への入場許可とは限らないので、こちらで担当者を確認します。打ち合わせの資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: That might have been a signal directing a work vehicle. It doesn't necessarily mean visitors may enter, so we'll check the contact here. Do you have the meeting documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資料はあります。私の会社に電話して、佐藤さんの所属と連絡先を聞いた方がいいでしょうか。車両の通り道から離れて電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料はあると答え、車両の通路を避けて自社へ担当の所属と連絡先を聞けばよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I have the documents. Should I call my company and ask for Mr. Sato's department and contact details? I'll move away from the vehicle route to make the call.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have the documents, and ask whether to call your company for the contact's department and details while staying away from the vehicle route.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、安全な待機場所で確認してください。担当者がわかるまでは、車両の後ろを通ったり、作業区域へ入ったりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please check from a safe waiting area. Until we identify the contact, please don't walk behind vehicles or enter the work area.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社から連絡先が届きました。先方に到着を伝えて、迎えに来てもらうよう頼んでもいいですか。必要な保護具も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先が届いたと伝え、到着を知らせ迎えを頼んでよいか尋ね、必要な保護具も確認したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: My company has sent the contact details. May I tell him I've arrived and ask him to come and meet me? I'd also like to check what protective equipment is required.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you received the contact details, ask whether to announce your arrival and request pickup, and say you also want to check the required protective equipment.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その連絡先を受付で確認してから、担当者へ到着を伝えましょう。保護具や入場手順は、担当者の案内を受けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: After reception confirms those contact details, let's notify the person that you've arrived. We'll confirm protective equipment and entry procedures with their guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡先と名刺を受付に見せます。担当者の確認と保護具の案内が済むまで、安全な待機場所で待ち、一人では奥へ入りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名刺と連絡先を受付へ示し、担当確認と保護具の案内までは待機場所で待って単独では作業区域へ入らないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show reception the contact details and business card. I'll wait in the safe waiting area until the contact is confirmed and I've been told about protective equipment, and I won't go further in alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will show reception the card and contact details, wait until the contact and protective equipment instructions are confirmed, and not enter the work area alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。到着の連絡をお手伝いします。確認が済むまでこちらでお待ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll help notify them that you've arrived. Please wait here until the checks are complete. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。口座のことで、どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to ask about your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通帳に覚えのない引き落としがあります。札幌のこの窓口で、何の支払いなのか確認する方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 覚えのない口座引き落としについて、支払内容を調べる方法を窓口で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a debit in my bankbook that I don't recognize. I'd like to ask at this counter in Sapporo how to find out what payment it was for.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese at the counter how to investigate an unfamiliar debit from your account.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 該当する行をお示しください。日付と表示された名称を確認します。口座の名義はご本人でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the relevant line. I'll check the date and the name displayed. Is the account in your own name?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の口座です。この行だと思っていましたが、よく見ると先月のものでした。気になっているのは、その下の今月の引き落としです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の口座であり、最初に示した先月の行ではなく、その下の今月の行が対象だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's my account. I thought it was this line, but looking closely, that one was from last month. The debit I'm concerned about is this month's one below it.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that it is your account, and correct yourself: you mean this month's line below, not last month's line you first indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今月の行ですね。通帳の表示だけでは支払先を特定できない場合があります。契約しているサービスや、届いた請求の通知と照合したことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: This month's line, then. The bankbook entry alone may not identify the recipient. Have you compared it with services you subscribe to or billing notices you've received?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 携帯電話の請求通知は確認しましたが、合いませんでした。不正かどうかはわからないので、まず調べる方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯電話の請求通知とは一致せず、不正かどうかは未確定なので、まず確認方法を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I checked my mobile phone bill notice, but it didn't match. I don't know whether it's unauthorized, so first I'd like to know how to investigate it.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that it does not match your mobile phone billing notice, that you do not yet know whether it is unauthorized, and want to know how to check first.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できる情報の範囲と調査の手順をご案内します。本人確認が必要ですので、お持ちの確認書類を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll explain which information can be checked and the investigation procedure. We need to verify your identity; may I ask what identification you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 在留カードがあります。相談のメモに口座番号を全部書いて友人に送ろうとしていましたが、自分で確認してから必要なことだけ伝える方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 在留カードを持っており、友人に口座番号を全部送る前に、自分で調べて必要な情報だけ伝えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my residence card. I was going to write my full account number in a note and send it to a friend, but it would be better to check it myself first and tell them only what is necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you have your residence card and want to investigate yourself and share only necessary information before sending your full account number to a friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 口座や本人確認の情報は、むやみに他の方へ送らないようにしてください。窓口では担当者の案内に従って提示し、不明な点はその場でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please avoid casually sending account or identity-verification information to others. At the counter, present it as directed by the staff and ask about anything unclear on the spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 口座情報は友人に送らず、ここで本人確認を受けます。今月の該当行を示して、調査方法と次に自分が確認するものを教えてもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人には口座情報を送らず窓口で本人確認を受け、今月の該当行の調査手順と自分で確認する資料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't send my account information to my friend. I'll have my identity checked here. I'll point out the relevant line for this month, and would like you to explain how to investigate it and what I should check next.
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not send account details to your friend, will verify your identity at the counter, and ask about the investigation procedure for this month's entry and documents you should check.

DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。該当行と確認書類を担当者が確認し、調べられる範囲をご説明します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-001-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. The adviser will check the relevant line and your identification, then explain what can be investigated. Thank you for your inquiry.
